text: do u know why when adding image to face it does this [Image #4]
resolution: Diagnosed the 'small floating image' bug. A placed face's texture capture is SQUARE (cols=floors=1), but a decal <Image> preserves its aspect ratio — so a landscape upload (e.g. the bliss wallpaper) filled the square's width but underfilled its height, and because the decal background is transparent, the wall rendered SEE-THROUGH in the gap, leaving only a small image patch floating. It read fine in the browser swatch because that box is landscape (66x38) so the image overflows-and-clips there, hiding the gap. Fix: imageDecalDoc now builds a SQUARE canvas that the image COVERS (fills, center-cropped) instead of an aspect-matched full-bleed canvas — the image node carries the image's own aspect (so no shrink) and the canvas overflow:hidden crops the overhang, so the face reads fully clothed like a wallpaper. The change is isolated to the pure doc-builder (faceTextureDoc.ts); 5/5 headless tests green (cover/contain, portrait, large-clamp, tiny, label); cart bundles clean. Note this covers (center-crops) rather than fits the whole image — /compose remains the route for precise framing/positioning.
